description: Use when a SOQL query is running slowly, causing timeouts, or returning UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW errors in large data volume orgs. Covers index-aware query writing, selectivity rules, the Query Plan tool, skinny tables, and dynamic field-set queries. Triggers: slow soql query, query timeout, non-selective query, query plan tool, index usage, soql optimization, large object performance. NOT for org-wide large-data-volume architecture — ownership or account data skew, Big Object archival, tens of millions of rows on one object — use architect/large-data-volume-architecture. NOT for the custom-index or composite-index request itself — use data/custom-index-requests. NOT for Apex CPU or heap governor limits — use apex/apex-cpu-and-heap-optimization. NOT for writing basic SOQL — use apex/soql-fundamentals.
inputs: The SOQL query or queries that are performing poorly
Object name and approximate record count
Error message if any (UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW, QUERY_TIMEOUT, etc.)
name: soql-query-optimization
official_sources: Best Practices for Deployments with Large Data Volumes (`salesforce_large_data_volumes_bp.txt`): standard and custom index thresholds with the 2M/5M/500K worked examples (L463-471); only the failing index is excluded (L472); AND 20%, OR 10%, all OR fields indexed, LIKE sampling of 100,000 rows (L476-481); the AND twice-threshold and intersection test and the OR tip (L279-293); default indexed fields and unindexable field types (L308, L399-409); custom index by Support or by deploying a custom index XML file via the Metadata API (L395); External ID field types (L418-424); null rows excluded from index tables and the rebuild requirement (L436-438); non-deterministic formula cases (L485-505); cross-object notation (L515); two-column indexes (L524-538); custom indexes copied to all sandboxes (L398) and skinny tables copied to Full sandboxes only (L381-385); skinny-table objects, contents, omission of soft-deleted rows, and the "magic wand" warning (L329-351); nightly statistics (L315-319); soft-deleted rows still affect queries, 15-day retention, hard delete (L735-742, L1021); OR decomposition, negative filters, IN lists, NA placeholder (L949-980); LIMIT starting at 100,000 as a last resort (L1011); ORDER BY ... LIMIT 99999 sort-optimization case (L1220-1237); Recycle Bin kept empty in the report case (L1258).

Apex Developer Guide (`salesforce_apex_developer_guide.txt`): selective-query criteria and the trigger emphasis (L9625-9632); default indexes including External ID and Unique, auto-indexing, unindexable types, TEXT() on picklist, and the cases where a custom index isn't used (L9641-9663); record counts include soft-deleted rows, and the `Name != ''` example (L9666-9693); ALL ROWS (L9959-9961).

REST API Developer Guide (`api_rest.txt`): Query Performance Feedback (Beta) `explain` parameter, API 30.0+, plans sorted most to least optimal, `leadingOperationType` values, and `relativeCost` above 1.0 meaning not selective (L17784-17867); worked response (L3810-3866).
Metadata API Developer Guide (`api_meta.txt`): CustomIndex type, `.indx-meta` suffix, API 50.0+, Support contact required, `allowNullValues` and `booleanIndexedValue` fields (L41099-41138).
